title: Pharmacy Inventory Agent
short: A working AI inventory agent: stockout alerts, batch-level expiry risk, losses at cost and a daily PDF report for the pharmacist.
problem: Stock-outs of essential medicines next to money lost on expired products, with ordering based on habit rather than data.
why: An empty shelf is a patient leaving without their medicine; expired stock is lost money.
solution: An agent that calculates days of cover, flags stock that will run out before the supplier can deliver, simulates First-Expired-First-Out sell-through for every batch, values risk at purchase cost and writes a 7-section PDF report with a prioritized action plan.
limitations: Tested only on fictional sample data so far; real pharmacy data is the next step
Runs when opened: nightly 11 PM delivery and instant alerts need a connection to the pharmacy system
Seasonality needs at least one year of sales history
Recommends only: never orders, edits records or disposes of stock

screenshots.caption: Dashboard on the fictional sample pharmacy: summary, alerts and inventory
Generated PDF report: executive summary and stockout predictions

symptom: The shelf is empty — or full of expired stock
ingredient: An inventory agent that reads your stock file
directions: Upload the inventory and sales files. Get alerts, reorder quantities with the maths shown, expiry risk per batch and a PDF report.
data: Inventory per batch: drug, quantity, expiry, batch number
Purchase price, supplier, lead time, min/max levels
review: The pharmacist approves every order, stock change and disposal; the agent never acts on its own.
